PRESS RELEASE October 29, 2026

Apple reports fourth quarter results

Fixture Valley, California — Apple today announced financial results for its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter ended September 26, 2026. The Company posted quarterly revenue of $101.2 billion, up 7 percent year over year, and quarterly diluted earnings per share of $1.85, up 9 percent year over year.

“Our September quarter set a record for Services revenue, and customers responded enthusiastically to iPhone Duo,” said the CEO in this synthetic fixture.

Apple’s board of directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.27 per share of the Company’s common stock. The dividend is payable on November 12, 2026 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 9, 2026.

Apple will provide live streaming of its Q4 2026 financial results conference call beginning at 2:00 p.m. PT on October 29, 2026. This press release contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties.
